flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (e-reminder after the 1st letter and the opt-out exclusion list), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (selection of notices with next stage RD2 for MHA and for Toppan), agencies/mha/{upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper,download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper} (mha_reg address update), datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (FIN/UEN), agencies/toppan/upload/{models/ToppanStage,jobs/ToppanUploadJob} (stage RD1 to RD2), cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no relevant code for this story
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 1 point. The story asks that after the e-reminder referring to the 1st letter was sent (or the owner opted out), OCMS runs the owner particulars checks and updates (Epic OCMS8) so the 2nd letter (RD2) can be sent. In code this is not one chain: eNotification, MHA upload/download, DataHive UEN/FIN and Toppan are separate crons that do not wait for each other. MHA selects RD2 notices (NRIC owners) through OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:565 and stores the returned address as mha_reg; Toppan selects notices with next stage RD2 (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:608-612) with no condition that the e-reminder was sent. What lowers the claim: (1) the eNotification cron is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), so the e-reminder after the 1st letter only runs through a manual trigger; (2) the FIN/UEN refresh through DataHive is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, :52); (3) MHA results still have the open defect OCMS-DF-2026-183 (Pending Closure) and the address path was broken before in OCMS-DF-2026-130. The demo remark mentions Vault; whether Vault is used and whether the connection permission exists: cannot verify from repo. Per-environment property values in Azure: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Partial claim: RD2 notice selection, NRIC address update through MHA and opt-out exist; the e-reminder after the 1st letter and the FIN/UEN refresh are off in prod config, and MHA results still have an open defect

steps.step: After the 1st letter (RD1), OCMS sends the vehicle owner an electronic reminder referring to the 1st letter
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder selects notices whose last_processing_stage is RD1 (also RD2..DR3) whose due date is inside the ENOTEDAYS window and that have no send record at that stage (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1162); NotificationSmsEmailJob calls it at :161-162 and uses the last stage as the template stage (:170-177), so an RD1 notice uses the RD1 template. Partial because cron.notification.enabled=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), so the job only runs through POST notification-main/trigger (CombinedSchedulerTriggerController.java:105-108). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (remarks: 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate') confirms the cron is not active. The RD1 template text in ocms_template_store (DB) and the values in Azure: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: An owner who opted out of electronic reminders is excluded from the e-reminder and the notice stays on the letter track
steps.detail: The reminder query drops id_no values found in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134); the job loads the exclusion list once (loadAllExcludedIds, :1207-1215) and skips excluded records before SMS/email is prepared (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-241). The Toppan letter selection query reads neither the exclusion list nor the e-reminder records (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:608-612), so an opted-out owner still reaches the 2nd letter. The exclusion list content is DB data: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS selects notices due for the 2nd letter (next stage RD2) with an NRIC owner to check particulars with MHA
steps.detail: findNoticesForMhaNricUpload selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date up to tomorrow, not suspended, owner id_type 'N' (NRIC) and offender_indicator 'Y', not HST (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:559-581). MhaNricDataHelper calls it at :81. The MHA upload cron is enabled in prod, running 09:00, 14:00, 21:00 Monday-Saturday (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). There is no condition that the e-reminder was sent; the order against the e-reminder is only the schedule. MHA response: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The latest address from the MHA result is saved as the owner particulars
steps.detail: MhaNricDownloadHelper stores the new address from the MHA result file as mha_reg rows: insert new rows (:1345-1349) or bulk UPDATE existing rows (:1352-1356); the MHA download cron is enabled in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120). Partial because OCMS-DF-2026-183 (Pending Closure, Prod deployed, Job ID ZUR120PC) reports that the system fails to process and update the MHA result data into the backend tables, so the defect on this step is not closed; OCMS-DF-2026-130 (Closed: old address fields not cleared) is already fixed in main. The MHA result file content and the state in prod: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Non-NRIC owners (FIN/UEN) also have their particulars checked through DataHive before the 2nd letter
steps.detail: DataHiveUenFinService selects notices at next stage RD1..DR3 (including RD2) for FIN/UEN owners (DataHiveUenFinService.java:217-248) and runs as the second job after the MHA download (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:100-105). Partial because cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false and cron.mhadownload.datahive=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:50-52), so the job is skipped; in UAT both are true. Non-NRIC owner particulars are not refreshed automatically before the 2nd letter in the repo's prod configuration. Values in Azure: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice is ready for the 2nd letter reminder (next stage RD2, due, not suspended)
steps.detail: After the 1st letter is delivered, ToppanUploadJob.confirmDeliveryAndAdvanceStage calls updateProcessingStage (ToppanUploadJob.java:444) which sets the next stage from the enum: RD1 goes to RD2 with a 14-day duration (ToppanStage.java:19-20). findToppanNoticesForStage('RD2') then picks notices with next_processing_stage = 'RD2', next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, offender_indicator 'Y' and not an Advisory Notice (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:596-614), called from ToppanUploadJob.java:248. Delivery of the file to the vendor is assessed in OCMS11.12.
